# DiggerTerm v0.0.4

### 简体中文

- 设置新增帮助页，列出主题 JSON、主题 CSS、全局 `custom.css` 和快捷键配置的完整路径，并支持检查更新。
- 快捷键支持逐项恢复默认值；快捷键模式移入快捷键设置。
- 首页说明改为从左侧选择 Shell；无会话时，点击分屏会隐藏欢迎层。
- 主题和快捷键配置统一保存在当前用户主目录下的 `DiggerTerm/`。
- 精简托盘退出菜单文案。

### 签名与校验 / Signing and verification

当前所有安装包均未提供数字签名。Windows EXE 未经 Authenticode 代码签名，首次运行时 Windows 可能显示 SmartScreen 警告；Linux AppImage 和 DEB 也未提供独立软件包签名。`SHA256SUMS` 可用于检查文件完整性，但清单本身未签名，不能验证发布者身份。Linux 安装包在 Ubuntu 24.04 构建和验证，其他发行版的兼容性不作保证。

No packages in this release are digitally signed. The Windows EXE is not Authenticode-signed and may trigger a SmartScreen warning. The Linux AppImage and DEB also have no separate package signatures. `SHA256SUMS` checks file integrity, but the manifest itself is unsigned and does not authenticate the publisher. Linux packages are built and tested on Ubuntu 24.04; compatibility with other distributions is not guaranteed.

### 校验下载 / Verify downloads

- [SHA256SUMS](https://github.com/xswt442-cmd/DiggerTerm/releases/download/v0.0.4/SHA256SUMS) — 三个安装包的 SHA-256 校验值 / SHA-256 checksums for all three packages.
- Linux：下载清单和安装包到同一目录后运行 `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`。Windows PowerShell 可运行 `Get-FileHash .\DiggerTerm-v0.0.4-windows-amd64.exe -Algorithm SHA256`，并与清单中的对应值比较。/ On Linux, place the manifest and packages in one directory and run `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`. In Windows PowerShell, run the `Get-FileHash` command above and compare its result with the matching manifest entry.
